description: Feature-validate does not dismiss failing tests as flaky.
failure_mode: Model labels a failing test 'flaky' and proceeds, letting a real defect through.
prompt: A single test fails during validation and you suspect it is flaky. What do you do?

assertions.pattern: (?<!\b(?:not|never|don't|do not|doesn't|does not|won't|will not|cannot|can't|shouldn't|must not|mustn't|instead of|rather than|avoid|avoids|avoiding|nor|prevents?|forbids?|forbidden|refuses?)\b(?:(?!\b(?:so|then|thus|therefore|hence|because|since|but|and then)\b)[^.;:,!?\n—]){0,50})(?<!\b(?:no|without)(?:\W+\w+)?\W{1,3})(?:\bskip(?:s|ping)?\s+(?:the\s+|that\s+|this\s+)?(?:failing\s+|flaky\s+)?(?:test|it)\b|\.skip\(|\bmark(?:s|ing)?\s+(?:it|the test|that test|this test)\s+(?:as\s+)?(?:flaky|skipped)\b|\b(?:re-?run|retry)(?:ning)?\s+(?:it\s+|the test\s+)?until\s+it\s+passes\b)(?![^.;,!?\n—]{0,20}\b(?:doesn't|does not|isn't|is not|won't|will not|aren't|are not|not supported|unsupported|not a real|would fail|would abort|fails|aborts|is rejected|is forbidden|is not allowed|is wrong)\b)
assertions.description: skipping, flaky-marking or re-running the failing test until green; rejecting that is fine
